@@U02772@@
Ripe and fresh as a juicy peach!
The delicate, sweetly swelling lips!

@@U02774@@
A cup, [ll wager, you long to sip at.

@@U02776@@
He’s very pretty, but lacks refinement.

@@U02778@@
He could be a bit less awkward, too.

@@U02780@@
Too much of the shepherd about him.
Where’s the prince, the courtly manners?

@@U02782@@
Yes, well, half naked he’s handsome enough;
but first we'd have to see him in armor.

@@U02784@@
Look at the graceful way he sits.

@@U02786@@
A lap, I dare say, you wouldn't mind sitting on?

@@U02788@@
How prettily he rests his arm on his head.

@@U02790@@
How vulgar!
It isn’t proper!

@@U02792@@
You gentlemen find fault with everything.
translation:
@@U02772@@
成熟又新鲜，就像多汁的桃子一样！
娇嫩的嘴唇，甜甜的！

@@U02774@@
一杯，[我打赌，你渴望啜饮。

@@U02776@@
他很漂亮，但缺乏精致。

@@U02778@@
他也可以不那么尴尬。

@@U02780@@
关于他的牧羊人太多了。
王子在哪里，宫廷礼仪在哪里？

@@U02782@@
是的，好吧，半裸的他已经够帅了；
但首先我们得看看他穿着盔甲。

@@U02784@@
看看他优雅的坐姿。

@@U02786@@
我敢说，你不介意坐一圈吗？

@@U02788@@
他把手臂搁在头上，多么漂亮啊。

@@U02790@@
多么粗俗啊！
这是不合适的！

@@U02792@@
你们先生们对一切都挑剔。
